title: The Great Sock Amnesty
skyStory: One percent of a moon peeks out of Aquarius, the thinnest eyelash of light, and declares a cosmic amnesty. All lost things may return without punishment. Socks, pens, the remote, a forgotten idea from July. Saturn grumbles about precedent. Mars says let them come home. The moon sides with Mars for once, and the universe sighs happily.

reading: A lazy Sunday has been declared, and the cabin approves. Sleep in if you can. Wear the softest thing you own. If anyone asks what you are doing today, the official answer is recharging, and it is said with total confidence.

Somewhere in your laundry pile lives a sock that lost its partner in October. Today it reunites. Hold the pair up to the light like a trophy. The [[Six of Pentacles]] notes that you are capable of receiving small mercies, even from a dryer. Practice on the sock. Work up to people.
joel.mission: Find one lost thing today, celebrate its return with a small speech, and put it somewhere it will never vanish again.
joel.omen: Two mismatched socks side by side. It means a friendly reunion is coming your way this week.
joel.elementWhy: a soft day for soft things

reading: Rest is not a reward you have to earn, says the moon, very seriously, from behind a cloud. You know this. You tell other people this. Today you get to practice what you preach, preferably under a blanket with a story you have been meaning to finish.

The shore is quiet and wintry. Somewhere, ice is creaking politely along the edge of the water. Let the day be shapeless. If a small chore appears, give it a polite nod and walk past it like a cat ignoring a call. The [[Nine of Cups]] wants to see you satisfied without anything to prove.
nancy.mission: Spend thirty minutes doing something purely for fun, and refuse to explain it to anyone.
nancy.omen: Ice crystals on a window shaped like ferns. It means rest today grows something lovely tomorrow.
nancy.stoneWhy: soft shimmer for a soft day

together.text: Declare a joint lazy Sunday. Text each other only once, at exactly 3 pm, with a single word describing your current level of cosiness. Bonus points for inventing a new word. The universe is officially closed for maintenance until Monday.

game.intro: Sock amnesty day: all strays forgiven. Saturn is less forgiving about guesses that go over.
game.question: How many tiles are in a standard double-six set of dominoes? Smug bonus if you spot why it suits February.
